beats.speaker: witness
beats.text: Last winter the watch found my cart in the drifts. I came to hear the next watch give its word.

beats.speaker: captain
beats.text: I have one lantern and two roads. Where shall the first patrol carry it?

options.label: Keep the bridge lit for the night crossing.
Meet the last carters on the south road.

beats.speaker: captain
beats.text: The bridge, then. If a wolf sees our lantern from the far bank, they will know someone is waiting.

beats.speaker: captain
beats.text: Who are you hoping the patrol will meet? Give me a name or a reason for carrying the light.

beats.speaker: captain
beats.text: Some names are yours to keep. I swear the same oath for every carter still on the road.

beats.speaker: captain
beats.text: We take the south road. Keep the light low, and listen for wheels. No carter comes home alone.

ai.personality: Harrow is a plain-spoken veteran who commands Greyfen’s watch and counts every wolf before shutting the gate.
ai.intent: Answer the volunteer’s concern in one short line and swear to meet the carters. Promise only to send the patrol on the south road.
